tool_input.command: cp app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts /tmp/pc.bak && git stash list >/dev/null; git checkout HEAD -- app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts && bun test tests/PostSearch.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -12; cp /tmp/pc.bak app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts
tool_input.description: Verify tests fail against original code

result:
Fixed and verified — `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` (5 tests) both pass, `guren check` reports 0 failures.

The bug was in `PostController.search` (`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`): the `published` filter sat *inside* the keyword grouping callback as `q.orWhere('published', true)`, so it was OR'd alongside the title/excerpt LIKE conditions rather than AND'd with them. That produced `(title LIKE … OR excerpt LIKE … OR published = true)` — which both padded results with every published post regardless of keyword and, more seriously, let any unpublished post matching a keyword through. I moved `published` out of the callback into a sibling `.where('published', true)` on the builder, so the query is now `(title LIKE … OR excerpt LIKE …) AND published = true`, and left a short comment explaining why it has to stay outside the group. I also added `tests/PostSearch.test.ts`, which seeds published and unpublished posts sharing keywords against the test SQLite database (via `resetDatabase()` from `config/database.ts`) and asserts that one keyword returns only the published match, that multiple keywords still leak nothing, and that a word appearing only in unpublished posts returns an empty result.
